primary_question: Does the Sprint-3 synaptic/presynaptic signal represent a direct inherited cognition effect rather than a signal materialised by population structure, assortative mating, indirect family effects or shared UK-Biobank sampling?
new_data_read_before_freeze: none. Metadata only: the public OpenGWAS gwasinfo.json entries for ieu-b-4837/4838 and the Zenodo 11066096 file listing (names, sizes, md5).

frozen_sets.name: voltage-gated ion channel activity involved in regulation of presynaptic membrane potential (GO:0099508)

gene_analysis.model: SNP-wise mean (MAGMA default), 10 kb window, NCBI37.3 gene locations
gene_analysis.snp_matching: by rsID against g1000_eur.bim; files without rsIDs are mapped by GRCh37 chr:pos:alleles to the bim; GRCh38 inputs must be lifted or rsID-mapped before use
gene_analysis.n_rule: per-SNP N column when present, else the dataset-level N from verified metadata

gene_set_model.what_sign_means: MAGMA gene statistics are unsigned (from P-values). A positive set beta means set genes carry MORE association than matched genes, in either allelic direction. It is enrichment concordance, not allele-direction concordance. Allele direction is tested separately at the locus level.

datasets.identity_check: all listed fields must equal the verified metadata AND the VCF header must carry the same dataset ID; a mismatch makes Gate A NOT_TESTABLE

gate_a.access: OpenGWAS automated download requires a JWT in OPENGWAS_JWT. No account is created and no website download is automated on the user's behalf.
gate_a.vcf_fields: ES (effect of ALT), SE, LP (-log10 P), AF (ALT frequency), SS (per-SNP N if present)
gate_a.effective_n_rule: N_eff(WF) = N(pop) x median over SNPs with 0.05<=AF<=0.95 of (SE_pop/SE_wf)^2. Depends on sampling design only, never on effect sizes.
gate_a.howe_shrinkage_status: brief states ~22% genome-wide shrinkage for cognition; to be checked against Howe 2022 text. A literature correction is allowed as a recorded pre-data amendment ONLY while no within-family association value has been read.

calibration.method: LD-aware summary-statistic subsampling (PUMAS-style; Zhao et al. 2021 Nat Commun): z_sim = f*sqrt(n/N)*z_obs + sqrt(1 - f^2*n/N)*e, e ~ N(0, R_block) generated as X_block' u / sqrt(503) from standardised g1000_eur genotypes with independent u ~ N(0, I) per LDetect EUR block (Berisa & Pickrell 2016), e aligned to the summary-statistic effect allele. Same noise draws reused across scenarios (common random numbers). Each replicate goes through the identical MAGMA gene and gene-set pipeline.
calibration.pre_data_source: Davies 2018 open subset (N=282,014): expectation available now
calibration.post_data_source: Howe population estimate ieu-b-4838 subsampled to N_eff(WF): primary expectation once the data exist
calibration.n_grid_note: 22,593 = Howe population N; 9,997 = Howe sibling N (individuals); 4,999 = ~half, the effective N of a sibling-difference design with pairs

set_classification.CONCORDANT_BUT_UNDERPOWERED: beta_wf > 0, P_wf >= 0.05, and beta_wf >= 2.5th percentile of the simulated distribution at N_eff(WF) with f = howe_shrinkage_f
set_classification.INCONSISTENT: beta_wf < 2.5th percentile of that distribution (BEYOND_EXPECTED_NOISE), or beta_wf <= 0 inside it (SIGN_DISCORDANT_WITHIN_NOISE; cannot drive PIVOT)
set_classification.NOT_TESTABLE: data absent, identity check failed, harmonisation failed, or set absent
set_classification.attenuation_ratio: beta_wf / beta_pop (Howe); 95% CI by parametric bootstrap (10,000 draws, independent normals: conservative because the two estimates share individuals); Fieller CI when |beta_pop/SE_pop| > 2

locus_rules.lead_snp: min-P Davies SNP within [min gene start - 10 kb, max gene stop + 10 kb] of the locus's Bonferroni genes (ties: larger |Z|, then lower position)
locus_rules.harmonisation: match on rsID; alleles compared case-insensitively; strand flip allowed for non-palindromic SNPs only; palindromic (A/T, C/G) SNPs with ALT frequency in [0.40, 0.60] are UNRESOLVED_HARMONISATION
locus_rules.proxy: if the lead is absent, best g1000_eur proxy with r^2 >= 0.8 within 500 kb; otherwise NOT_TESTABLE
locus_rules.cognition_allele: the Davies allele with positive Z (Davies: higher = better cognition)
locus_rules.winners_curse: expected WF z uses Tweedie's formula E[mu|z] = z + d/dz log f(z), with f a Gaussian KDE of Davies Z over every 50th SNP genome-wide

classes.DIRECT_SUPPORTED: aligned WF z > 0 and one-sided P < 0.05
classes.CONCORDANT_UNDERPOWERED: aligned WF z > 0 and one-sided P >= 0.05
classes.NOT_TESTABLE: absent, no proxy, or unresolved harmonisation

global_tests: binomial sign concordance vs 0.5 over testable loci
expected concordance under f=1 and f=howe_shrinkage_f
slope of beta_wf on beta_pop through the origin (inverse-variance)
Spearman of Davies |z| rank vs aligned WF z

gate_b.primary_phenotype_note: TMA is treated as the executive-function (alphanumeric switching) trail-making condition. If the source defines the files otherwise, the primary becomes the alphanumeric condition, recorded as a pre-data amendment before any association value is read.
gate_b.direction: set from the phenotype definition only: if a higher value is slower/worse, the cognition-aligned z is -z. Never inferred from the data or from NT5DC2.

set_classification.INDEPENDENT_SUPPORT: P_gc < 0.05 (one-sided competitive), primary phenotype; Bonferroni over 6 sets (0.05/6) reported alongside
set_classification.INCONSISTENT: beta_gc < 2.5th percentile of the simulated distribution at n=9,997 with f = f_gc_lower (BEYOND_EXPECTED_NOISE); beta_gc <= 0 inside it is SIGN_DISCORDANT_WITHIN_NOISE
set_classification.NOT_TESTABLE: file absent, md5 mismatch, direction undeterminable, or set absent
set_classification.f_gc_lower_rule: rg(primary phenotype, general cognition) if verified from the source paper; otherwise 0.5
set_classification.expectation_note: Davies-subsampled expectations assume the trail-making phenotype carried the full general-cognition signal (f=1): an upper bound, not a prediction

gate_b.locus_support: G&C_SUPPORTED if aligned one-sided P < 0.05 in the primary phenotype OR min over the 3 phenotypes of aligned one-sided P x 3 < 0.05; BH-FDR across testable loci reported as confidence, not used as the gate

positive_control.pass_rule: our harmonised G&C estimate has the published sign and |beta_ours - beta_pub| <= 0.1*|beta_pub| + 0.001 and P within a factor of 2 of the published P
positive_control.note: a pipeline check; NT5DC2 is prenatal-dominant (Sprint 3) and is not promoted to an adult target by replicating

survivors.C: exceptionally strong prior human evidence (Davies lead P < 1e-15 AND a biology-driven (non-positional) L2G call in fine_mapping_support.csv) AND Gate-A locus CONCORDANT_UNDERPOWERED
survivors.stress_test_rule: always carried into Gate C, labelled STRESS_TEST; not survivors unless A/B/C holds
survivors.not_used: paper counts, top-50 membership, Sprint-1 seed status, theory nodes

fine_mapping.primary: Open Targets GWAS credible sets already fetched in Sprint 3 (study-first)
fine_mapping.susie_sensitivity: susieR::susie_rss on Davies z (n=282,014), window lead +/- 500 kb, LD from g1000_eur, L=10, coverage 0.95, min_abs_corr 0.5, estimate_residual_variance=FALSE
fine_mapping.ld_mismatch_flag: susieR::estimate_s_rss s > 0.2 flags the locus; kriging outliers (logLR > 2 and |z| > 2) counted
fine_mapping.never: lead SNP or nearest gene is never equated with the causal gene

gate_c.qtl_resources: eQTL Catalogue (public API/FTP; GTEx v8 brain, BrainSeq, ROSMAP, CommonMind or others as listed by its metadata), adult samples only; MetaBrain only if already accessible
gate_c.adult_rule: a QTL dataset counts as adult brain only if its donors are adults; datasets including prenatal or childhood samples are flagged and excluded from direction

coloc.method_order: coloc.susie when both sides have SuSiE fits with >=1 credible set; coloc.abf otherwise (reported as single-signal)

direction_rule.polarity: sign(beta_QTL / beta_GWAS) x trait polarity (-1 for reaction time, time to complete, decline, errors)
direction_rule.counting_unit_secondary: distinct adult-brain QTL dataset x tissue (majority sign per dataset); a robustness flag, never a relaxation
direction_rule.not_relaxed_for: NEGR1 (3/4 = 75% in Sprint 3) or any other gene
direction_rule.evidence_pooling: a (gene, dataset) pair is strong if the Open Targets COLOC h4 >= 0.8 OR our coloc PP.H4 >= 0.8; polarity from our harmonised analysis when available, else OT betaRatioSignAverage; disagreement between the two is reported and the pair counted as disagreeing

gate_c.joint_gene_tissue: attempt FOCUS or TGFM on <= 5 loci where one signal colocalises with >1 gene; if software/data make it impossible, record the blocker and make no substitute claim

decision.CONTINUE: >=1 frozen set DIRECT_EFFECT_SUPPORTED in Gate A AND (>=1 frozen set INDEPENDENT_SUPPORT in Gate B OR the Gate-B locus sign-concordance binomial P < 0.05 OR >=1 survivor with a direction-resolved adult-brain chain)
decision.PIVOT: >=3 of 6 frozen sets INCONSISTENT (BEYOND_EXPECTED_NOISE) in an adequately powered Gate A, OR >=3 of 6 INCONSISTENT (BEYOND_EXPECTED_NOISE) in Gate B with simulated power >= 0.5 at f_gc_lower
decision.STOP_CURRENT_HYPOTHESIS: the PIVOT condition holds in BOTH Gate A and Gate B
decision.RETRY_IF_GATE_A_UNTESTABLE: all six sets NOT_TESTABLE in Gate A (access, download, harmonisation or technical failure)
decision.ESCALATE: synaptic biology survives the direct/independent tests but no survivor gene is direction-resolved because the available adult-brain QTL data are inadequate; the resolving dataset must be named

opens_only_if_one_gene_has_all: independently supported cognition association (Gate B or Gate A DIRECT_SUPPORTED)
credible locus-to-gene evidence (non-positional L2G driver or joint gene-tissue fine-mapping)
adult human brain molecular evidence (strong coloc)
no disqualifying safety or pleiotropy signal

never: NOT_TESTABLE is never reported as NO_EFFECT
educational attainment is never direct cognition evidence
UKB-containing files are never counted as G&C independence
no new pathways are added; no new genome-wide tournament; no new weighted score
theory nodes (Selective Encoding, Goal-Gated Plasticity) select nothing
animal-memory data never rescue a failed human locus
the chemistry gate stays closed unless every criterion above is met
